item.title: Toru 0.4.5
item.description:
• The cursor moves like a hand: a curved path that slows into the target, with a short correction, and a moment of hesitation before buttons that create or send something
  • Gestures: your agent can point at, circle, underline or sweep down a list without clicking, and the camera frames it
  • Clicks inside one panel are filmed as one shot instead of zooming in and out
